# CBTMocks - Free Mock Tests for Competitive Exams (CAT, XAT, SNAP) - Full Context

> Complete background documentation, syllabus inventory, scoring models, and mission guidelines for CBTMocks (https://cbtmocks.online/), a 100% free open-access Computer Based Test (CBT) portal for Indian competitive MBA examinations: Common Admission Test (CAT), Xavier Aptitude Test (XAT), and Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP).

## Mission & Philosophy
CBTMocks was engineered to dismantle the predatory test series model prevalent in Indian competitive examination preparation. Commercial coaching institutes provide 1 or 2 sample tests as marketing bait, then lock their remaining question banks behind ₹5,000 to ₹15,000 paywalls while demanding phone numbers for telemarketing.

CBTMocks guarantees:
1. 100% Free Forever: All 65+ tests and 900+ questions are completely open.
2. Zero Registration: No email, phone number, or password required. All state persists in client-side localStorage.
3. Authentic CBT Simulation: Exact TCS iON CBT interface with countdown timers, official question palettes (Answered, Not Answered, Marked for Review), and built-in BODMAS virtual calculator for CAT.
4. Non-Intrusive Monetization: Monetized strictly through unobtrusive Google AdSense banners (never during active tests!) and voluntary community UPI donations (ayanmalaviya111@okhdfcbank).

## Test Series Inventory by Exam

### 1. Common Admission Test (CAT)
- Format: 120-Minute Official Full Mock Tests (3 Sections with 40-minute sectional locks).
- Structure: Section 1 VARC (40m, 24 Qs) -> Section 2 DILR (40m, 20 Qs) -> Section 3 QA (40m, 22 Qs).
- Total: 66 Questions, 198 Marks (+3 for correct, -1 for MCQ incorrect, 0 for TITA).
- On-Screen Calculator: Built-in draggable BODMAS calculator.
- Available Tests:
  - CAT 2026 National All-India Specimen Full Mock
  - CAT 2023 Official All-India Full Mock (Slot 2 VARC + Slot 1 DILR + Slot 1 QA)
  - CAT 2022 Official All-India Full Mock (Slot 2 VARC + Slot 3 DILR + Slot 2 QA)
  - CAT 2021 Slot 1 Official Full Mock
  - CAT 2020 Slot 1 Official Full Mock
  - 40-Minute Sectional Tests for Quantitative Aptitude, DILR, and VARC.

### 2. Xavier Aptitude Test (XAT)
- Format: 175-Minute Official Part 1 Papers (VALR, Decision Making, QA-DI).
- Structure:
  - Verbal Ability & Logical Reasoning (VALR): 26 Questions, 5 options (A-E).
  - Decision Making (DM): 21-22 Questions across 7 business/ethical caselets.
  - Quantitative Ability & Data Interpretation (QA-DI): 28 Questions (Geometry, Numbers, DI sets).
- Scoring: +1.0 mark for correct, -0.25 mark for incorrect.
- Available Tests:
  - XAT 2024 Official Full Mock Paper (75 Qs)
  - XAT 2023 Official Full Mock Paper (75 Qs)
  - XAT 2026 Specimen Full Mock Paper (75 Qs)
  - XAT 2024 Decision Making Sectional (NeoPharma, EcoCraft, TechSprint, GreenInfra, EdSmart, BioFuel, UrbanNest)
  - XAT 2023 Decision Making Sectional (Medix, FinServe, AutoDrive, LearnQuick, SpiceCrafters, CleanCity, PaisaFast)
  - XAT 2024 VALR and QA-DI Sectionals.

### 3. Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP)
- Format: 60-Minute Speed Marathon (60 Questions, No sectional time limits).
- Structure:
  - General English (GE): 15 Questions (Vocabulary, Idioms, Grammatical error spotting, Syllogisms).
  - Analytical & Logical Reasoning (LR): 25 Questions (Clocks, Calendars, Coding, Seating, Critical Reasoning).
  - Quantitative, DI & Data Sufficiency (QA-DS): 20 Questions (Fast arithmetic, P&C, Probability, Graphs).
- Scoring: +1.0 mark for correct, -0.25 mark for incorrect.
- Available Tests:
  - SNAP 2024 Official Speed Mock (60 Qs in 60 Mins)
  - SNAP General English Sectional (15 Qs)
  - SNAP Analytical Reasoning Sectional (25 Qs)
  - SNAP Quantitative Aptitude & Data Sufficiency Sectional (20 Qs).
